decisions.reason: As a next-generation high-resolution piezo inkjet printer, it builds directly on the firm's core inkjet coding knowledge, so absorptive capacity is high and drop risk is very low.
This software module for numbering extends existing digital printing software, closely related to current capabilities, so the firm can assimilate and improve it, drop risk low.
An inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces is core hardware within the firm's marking equipment competence, making discontinuation unlikely.
The mobile app leverages existing code-decoding and verification knowledge but is less central to machinery, giving a moderate but still minority drop probability.
Inline code verification integrates cameras and software with coding equipment, closely building on existing product verification knowledge, so drop risk is low.
Print layout design software complements the firm's printing systems and uses existing software/printing knowledge, though it is somewhat less core, leading to low-to-moderate drop risk.
